title: A column reference in ADDCOLUMNS gives the value of the current row

source.quote: New columns are computed in the row context of ADDCOLUMNS
source.supports: the added column is computed in the row context of ADDCOLUMNS

source.quote: The operator determines the type of conversion DAX performs by casting the values it requires before doing the requested operation.
source.supports: the multiplication table gives CURRENCY * INTEGER as CURRENCY

derivation: ALL over two columns returns the 4 existing combinations of Product and Price (sales has no orphans, so no blank row). Each row doubles its own Price: 100 * 2 = 200, 20 * 2 = 40, 10 * 2 = 20, 50 * 2 = 100.
